identity.notes: 6 LCO prismatic cells; CS2 type; Arbin workbooks; CC-CV charge at 0.5C; 0.5C, 1C, alternating-level and partial-SOC discharge groups

conditions.protocol_charge_raw: CC 0.5C to 4.2 V, then CV at 4.2 V until current drops below 0.05 A
conditions.protocol_discharge_raw: CC discharge at 0.5C (CS2_33, CS2_34) or 1C (CS2_35 to CS2_38) to 2.7 V

content.cycle_basis: Cycle_Index of the Arbin data sheets; workbooks of one cell continue the count
content.count_basis: 6 cells (CS2_33-CS2_38), the full CS2 release, not the whole CALCE portal; 5,686 cycle indices across 152 cycling tables.

quality.notes: Raw_Dataset holds only Arbin workbooks (an Info sheet and Channel data sheets); no README or cell specification ships with them. The CALCE battery-data landing page lists several battery models on one page (INR 18650-20R, A123, CS2, CX2, PL); an earlier pass mistakenly cited the page's first table (INR 18650-20R, 2000 mAh) instead of the CS2-specific one (1100 mAh), which is what these CS2_n cells actually are. The Arbin schedule name in the Info sheet is CS2_point5C. Charging profile: no documentation ships with the dataset; the charge is the same CC-CV, the discharge rate differs between cell groups. The registry tag 0.5C_1C matches CS2_35 to CS2_38 only; CS2_33 and CS2_34 discharge at 0.5C. No primary data paper has been identified. Two CALCE-related papers use similar cells but do not name the CS2: He et al., J. Power Sources 196 (2011) 10314 (two LiCoO2/graphite types, 0.9 and 1.1 Ah, Arbin BT2000, room temperature, 1.1 A = 1C discharge for the 1.1 Ah type) and Xing et al., Microelectronics Reliability 53 (2013) 811 (1.35 Ah and 1.1 Ah cells, CC-CV charge, 1C discharge, about 25 C). Neither states the CS2 name, prismatic format, manufacturer, cell count or the 0.5C charge; the CALCE page (calce.umd.edu/battery-data) remains the only source for those. The user-supplied snapshot of the CALCE data page (copyright 2014) states the delivered cells' protocols directly: CS2_33 and CS2_34 at constant 0.5C, CS2_35 to CS2_38 at constant 1C, every test with the same 0.5C CC-CV charge to 4.2 V (0.05 A cut-off) and a 2.7 V discharge cut-off unless specified. The page's other protocols (alternating 0.11 to 2.2 A currents, random cut-off, partial-SOC cycling) belong to other CS2 cells (CS2_3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 24, 25) that are not in this dataset, so they no longer appear in the protocol text and the protocol class is CC-CV. The page also lists the cell weight (21.1 g without the safety circuit) and a jelly roll wound around the length axis. The page asks users to cite the CALCE battery database and at least three CALCE-referenced articles; it names no single primary paper, so this page remains the only primary description. Arbin Info sheets (re-read in all six zips): the schedule is CS2_point5C.sdu for CS2_33 and CS2_34 and CS2_1C.sdu for CS2_35 to CS2_38, matching the CALCE page; the delivered tests ran from 2010-08-31 to 2011-01-24; the temperature column is empty (no temperature channel). Primary source: the saved CALCE data page (source_papers/user_supplied/dataset_02); there is no paper and no paper DOI.
